title: Wife's wedding ring moved and found by prayer

tellings.quote: So, her wedding ring was actually moved.

plain: In 2024 a wedding ring belonging to a woman named Kristen, the wife of Brandon Fugal, is said to have moved by itself inside the Fugal home, and was then found again after prayer. Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, tells Michels what his wife told him: "her wedding ring was actually moved." If it happened as told, the strangeness tied to the ranch would have followed the family into their home.
